faq_q_1: Do I need my own WhatsApp Business number?
faq_a_1: No — Kedaipal runs one Meta-verified WhatsApp Business Account for all sellers. No Meta business verification, no waiting weeks for approval. Your store name appears in every message, and you're live in under 5 minutes.
faq_q_2: Do I need a registered company?
faq_a_2: No. Kedaipal handles all WhatsApp Business API access centrally — you never need to register with Meta. A registered company is not required to use Kedaipal.
faq_a_3: Two ways. Connect your own HitPay account and buyers tap Pay now — DuitNow QR, FPX, cards, e-wallets — with the money settling straight to you and the order marking itself paid. Or take bank transfer / cash: Kedaipal sends your payment details, tracks the “I've paid” handshake, and issues the receipt. Kedaipal never touches your order money.
faq_a_4: Kedaipal currently supports English, Bahasa Malaysia, and Chinese. Tamil is on the roadmap.
faq_a_5: No. WhatsApp is where most sellers start because it's the channel their customers already use every day — but the same dashboard also powers your web storefront and in-person counter checkout, so your online and walk-in orders live in one place.
faq_q_6: What kinds of businesses is Kedaipal for?
faq_a_6: Kedaipal is built for any seller with a product catalog — F&B, fashion, beauty, handmade goods, home products, and more — taking 20+ orders a week on WhatsApp.
faq_a_7: You do. Every product, order and customer record is yours — CSV export is on the dashboard today. Cancel anytime and take everything with you.
faq_a_8: You get the full product free from day one — no credit card. Your first invoice only fires when you take your first live order, or on day 15, whichever comes first. Cancel any time before that and pay nothing.
faq_q_9: Will this work for me even if business is slow right now?
faq_a_9: When orders are slower, each missed follow-up costs more — not less. One recovered conversation this week could cover a month of subscription. Kedaipal makes sure none slip.
faq_a_10: A solo founder (Arif Rahman) building with the sellers who pay for it — real businesses transact through Kedaipal daily and shape the roadmap every week. Not a big team, but you'll always reach a person.
faq_q_11: I sell custom-made orders — can buyers approve a design first?
faq_a_11: Yes. Mark a product as needing mockup approval and its orders can't enter production until the buyer signs off on their tracking page. Payment is only asked for after approval — and if a buyer goes quiet, you can waive the gate after 48 hours.
faq_q_12: I sell at a stall too — does that work?
faq_a_12: Yes — that's exactly who we built for. Counter checkout gives your stall one QR: walk-ins scan, order and pair to WhatsApp on the spot. Counter and chat orders share one inbox, one stock count, and one customer list.
faq_a_13: Any courier on your own Delyva account — J&T Express, Ninja Van, Pos Malaysia, DHL eCommerce, City-Link, Flash Express and cold-chain lanes like Ninja Cold — quoted from the order, cheapest first, with the tracking number sent to your buyer on WhatsApp. Lalamove covers same-day riders in Malaysia and Singapore. Delyva's Singapore couriers are being enabled.

pricingpage_faq_q1: Can I switch tiers as my orders grow?
pricingpage_faq_a1: Yes — upgrade in one tap from your dashboard, takes effect immediately with prorated billing. Downgrade takes effect at the end of your current billing period. You can also cancel anytime; your data is kept for 90 days.
pricingpage_faq_a2: Each order has a single pickup/delivery address. Multi-pickup-point routing — where a single order can have different pickup locations (e.g. multiple collection points for a batch run) — ships with Scale. It's on the S5 roadmap. (Team-member seats are coming soon.)
pricingpage_faq_q3: How does Lalamove delivery work, and what about frozen or outstation orders?
pricingpage_faq_a3: Lalamove rider booking is live on Pro and Scale, using your own Lalamove account. Buyers see a live rider quote at checkout, and you dispatch in one tap from a packed order — motorcycle or car — with the tracking link pushed to the buyer automatically. That covers intra-city delivery. For frozen or outstation parcels you set up courier rate cards instead: your own zones and weight bands for J&T, DD Cold Chain, Ninja Cold and the rest, then paste the consignment number when you ship. Rate cards are on every plan.
pricingpage_faq_q4: What payment methods can my customers use?
pricingpage_faq_a4: Two rails, both settling straight to you. Connect your own HitPay account and buyers tap Pay now — DuitNow QR, FPX from every bank, Touch 'n Go, GrabPay, ShopeePay, Boost, Visa/Mastercard. Or take bank transfer, DuitNow QR and cash by hand, with the “I've paid” handshake and receipts. Kedaipal never touches your order money; HitPay's gateway fee is billed to you directly and we add nothing on top.
pricingpage_faq_q5: How does the 14-day free trial work?
pricingpage_faq_a5: You get full access to Pro features for 14 days — no credit card to start. When the trial ends, pick the plan that fits (Starter, Pro, or Scale) to keep going. Cancel anytime in between and pay nothing.
pricingpage_faq_q6: Does Kedaipal work if my customers are already chatting me on personal WhatsApp?
pricingpage_faq_a6: Yes. Your customers keep messaging whatever number they have for you. Kedaipal is a storefront + order system that connects via the CTA URL button in your WhatsApp Business profile — customers tap it, browse, cart, and the order comes back to you in WhatsApp. No app download, no new number.
